pages.title: Brine Evaporator
pages.text: Shallow pans of brine, warmed until the water goes and the salts come out, one after another.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the pan temperature and how much of the water is driven off. Each salt crystallises in its own band of concentration: gypsum first, then halite, then the lithium-rich bittern. Hotter is faster, but too fast and the crystals come out mixed.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 2 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Gypsum Crystal, Halite, Lithium Carbonate, Organic Evaporite.
